records.title: Converse A-Cold-Wall* x Chuck Taylor All Star Lugged High 'Triple Black' A-COLD-WALL Black Skate Shoes 169814C (Size: US 5.5)
records.description: The A-Cold-Wall* x Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Lugged High ‘Triple Black’ is a unique and stylish take on the classic high-top sneaker. Made with a nylon ripstop upper, ghillie lacing, and reflective zigzag stitching, this sneaker is perfect for any urban adventurer. The lugged rubber outsole provides extra traction and durability, while the monochromatic design makes it easy to mix and match with any outfit.

records.title: Converse x Ambush leather high-top sneakers - Black
records.description: Converse's collaboration with Ambush is one for the books. Doubly cool, these leather sneakers from the latest drop have a high-top silhouette that's best suits cropped jeans or shorts. What's more is that they'll suit practically any colour palette. Featuring rubber soles, lace-up front, logo stamps and brand patch.
